description: Ground truth for hand layup demo. Cup is on the scale from the start. Picking and returning actions can be performed by either the robot or the human.

events.description: Recording started, robot at home position. Cup is already on the scale.
Robot picks resin bottle from storage and places it at the workplace
Human adds resin from the bottle into the cup on the scale
Robot picks hardener bottle from storage and places it at the workplace
Human places the first fiberglass sheet on the mold
Human adds hardener from the bottle into the cup
Human stirs the resin and hardener together
Human applies resin to the first layer
Human places the second fiberglass sheet on top of the first
Human applies resin to the second layer
Human places the third fiberglass sheet
Human applies resin to the third layer
Human places the fourth and final fiberglass sheet
Human applies resin to the final layer
Robot picks roller, uses force-controlled rolling to consolidate layup, then returns roller
Human returns hardener bottle to storage
Robot picks resin bottle from workplace and returns it to storage

notes: Cup is on the scale from the start. Picking and returning actions (e.g. return_resin_to_storage, return_hardener_to_storage) can be performed by either the robot or the human.
